name: Footer
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Footer.
Set shared footer defaults, then add the actual menu and content blocks inside the active footer section. Column count controls layout; it does not create menu items.
Use your own policies and contact information. Review narrow screens and retain the native Shopify credit in the submitted demo.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.content: Choose and arrange footer designs in the Footer section group in the editor sidebar.

settings.label: Footer link columns
settings.info: Used by Footer One. Other footer designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust footer link columns. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Enable footer announcement bar
settings.info: Used by Footer One. Other footer designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable footer announcement bar” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Footer announcement text
settings.default: Subscribe & save 10% on your first order.
settings.info: Used by Footer One. Other footer designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Enter the footer announcement text. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Footer bottom (legal / credits)
settings.info: Used by Footer One. Other footer designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Enter the footer bottom (legal / credits). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
